signin.title: ChatGPT saaf karna shuru karne ke liye sign in karein
signin.subtitle: Free account mein roz ek bulk delete milta hai. Aapka plan aapke Google account ke saath har browser mein chalta hai.
signin.legacyCallout: Pehle {legacyPrice} pay kiya tha? Usi email wale Google account se sign in karein jisse payment kiya tha, aap apne aap Lifetime par upgrade ho jayenge. Woh email yaad nahi? Apni receipt yahan bhejein:
signin.legal: Google sirf aapka naam, email aur photo share karta hai. Continue karke aap <terms>Terms</terms> aur <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> se sahmat hote hain.
signin.error.failed: Sign in nahi ho paya. Phir se try karein.

notice.serverUnreachable: Server se connect nahi ho pa raha. Apna connection check karein aur extension dobara kholein.
notice.selectFirst: Pehle conversations select karein: {add} par click karein, phir jo chahiye unpe tick karein.
notice.serverRetry: Abhi server se connect nahi ho pa raha. Phir se try karein.
notice.wrongTab: Is tab par yeh nahi chal sakta. chatgpt.com kholein aur phir se try karein.

pricing.title: Bina kisi limit ke ChatGPT saaf karein
pricing.monthly.sub: Har mahine bill · kabhi bhi cancel karein
pricing.lifetime.sub: Ek baar pay karein, hamesha ke liye aapka
pricing.fine.recurring: Apne aap renew hota hai · Kabhi bhi cancel karein · Stripe se secure checkout

pricing.fine.upgrade: Ek baar ka payment · Aapka subscription renew nahi hoga · Stripe se secure checkout
pricing.error.alreadyLifetime: Aapke paas pehle se Lifetime hai.
pricing.error.alreadySubscribed: Aapka subscription pehle se hai. Plan badalne ke liye {manageBilling} use karein.
pricing.error.failed: Checkout shuru nahi ho paya. Phir se try karein.
pricing.maker: Ek indie developer ne banaya hai. ChatGPT apna interface aksar badalta hai, aur har badlav se yeh extension toot sakta hai. Aapka plan ise chalu rakhne mein lagne wale time ka kharcha uthata hai. Support ke liye shukriya!
pricing.contact: Aapke liye kaam nahi kar raha? Mujhe email karein:
account.title: Account
account.detail.free: Roz {runs, plural, one {# bulk delete} other {# bulk deletes}} · har run mein max {max, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}
account.detail.legacy: Aapki pichhli {price} wali kharid se upgrade kiya gaya. Shukriya!
account.detail.lifetime: Ek baar pay kiya. Hamesha ke liye aapka.
account.upgradeNote.credit: Aapka abhi ka {price} payment Lifetime mein gina jayega. Aapka subscription renew nahi hoga, isliye aage koi charge nahi lagega.
account.upgradeNote.noCredit: Aapka subscription renew nahi hoga, isliye aage koi charge nahi lagega.
account.billingError: Billing nahi khul payi. Phir se try karein.
account.help.title: Madad chahiye?
account.help.p1: ChatGPT apni website aksar update karta hai, aur kabhi kabhi koi badlav extension tod deta hai. Main inhe jitna jaldi ho sake fix karta hoon. Agar kuch kaam karna band kar de, toh please mujhe email karein.
account.help.p2: Billing ka sawal ya kuch aur? Yahi address. Pehle {legacyPrice} pay kiya tha par Lifetime par nahi hain? Apni receipt bhejein, main restore kar dunga.
legacy.title: Ab aap Lifetime par hain
legacy.text: Aapki pichhli {legacyPrice} wali kharid bina kisi extra charge ke Lifetime plan mein upgrade ho gayi hai.
legacy.noAds: Koi ads nahi, har us browser mein jahan aap sign in karein
limit.title: Aaj ka free run use ho gaya
limit.text: Pro lein aur abhi jitna chahein delete aur archive karein.
limit.textWithTime: Aapka agla free run {when} milega. Pro lein aur abhi jitna chahein delete aur archive karein.
runWarning.title: Shayad abhi yeh kaam na kare
runWarning.text: Jab tak fix nahi aata, kuch conversations delete ya archive nahi ho sakti. Aap phir bhi try kar sakte hain, ya notice hatne ke baad wapas aayein.
whatsNew.title: Naya: conversations ka preview
whatsNew.p1: {add} par click karne ke baad, har conversation ke checkbox ke paas ek eye icon aayega. Conversation jhaankne ke liye us par hover karein, ya preview khula rakhne ke liye click karein.
whatsNew.p2: Delete ya archive karne se pehle dekh lein ki conversation mein kya hai.
checkoutNotice.title: Subscribe karne se pehle
checkoutNotice.p1: ChatGPT samay samay par apni website update karta hai, aur koi update is extension ko band kar sakta hai. Aam taur par main ise kuch hi dinon mein fix kar deta hoon.
checkoutNotice.p2: Agar isse aapko dikkat hogi, toh please subscribe na karein. Agar subscribe karne ke baad extension kaam karna band kar de, toh mujhe <email>{supportEmail}</email> par email karein, main madad karunga.
